answer: Slashable identity bonds with random audits: to enter the reward horizon each agent locks collateral and registers one unique key. At an unpredictable moment an auditor sends a sealed whisper that only that key can open, tied to a fresh saffron nonce. A Sybil farmer must fund N bonds and keep N keys live; a missed or reused reply slashes the whole stake. Cost grows linearly with identities, with total-loss risk, so mass fakery never pays.
